app.title: HACS Trends
view.trending.title: Gaining attention
view.trending.note: The most new stars in the period. Stars show visibility, not use.
view.installed.title: Actually being used
view.installed.note: By installations actually running. Integrations only — {matched} of {withDomain} matched.
view.breakout.title: Rising for their size
view.breakout.note: Star growth in percent. From {minBase} stars at the start of the period.
view.momentum.title: Gaining and in use
view.momentum.note: Gaining stars and installations at the same time. Integrations only.
view.ships.title: Ships reliably
view.ships.note: By releases in the last year.
view.maintenance.title: Possibly unmaintained
view.maintenance.note: By time since the last commit. A finished project can run correctly for years without one.
view.fresh.title: New in HACS
view.fresh.note: Most recently accepted into the HACS store.
hint.rankKept: Position in this view's unfiltered ranking.
hint.ambiguousDomain: Several HACS repositories claim this integration domain, so the figure cannot be attributed to one of them.
hint.starsAdded: Stars given during the period. GitHub does not report removed stars, so this is not a net change.
hint.integrationsOnly: Installation figures exist for integrations only — dashboard cards, themes and templates are not reported.
hint.noAdoption: The release tag does not appear in the analytics data, so the share is unknown — which is not the same as zero.
hint.adoption: Share of reported installations running {v}, the newest release.
hint.noRelease: This repository has never published a release.
foot.empty: Nothing matches. Try a different search or clear the filters.
foot.downloadCoverage: download counter for only {pct}% — no ranking of its own
foot.installsSample: installs are an opt-in sample, integrations only
empty.installsGrowing: No data yet. Installation trends begin on {date}.
hint.releasesCapped: The fetch ceiling was reached - there may be more.
hint.sinceStart: Already there when the HACS list was written in 2019 - the exact date is not recorded.
hint.noAddedDate: No acceptance date in the HACS list - usually after a rename on GitHub.
